name: New 52-Week High by VIX Regime
description: Segments forward 5d, 21d, and 63d returns after new 52-week closing highs by VIX regime (Low < 15, Medium 15-25, High > 25). Tests whether negative drift and momentum divergence reflect macro-driven clustering near market tops. Universe: AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, META. Outputs: regime-segmented median return bars, 21d return boxplot by regime, event markers with VIX context, and regime stats table.
source:
# New 52-Week High by VIX Regime
# Segments forward returns after new 52-week highs by VIX level
# VIX regimes: Low (< 15), Medium (15-25), High (> 25)
# Universe: AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, META

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# VIX data (shared context — same for all assets)
vix_src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix = ffill(vix_src.c)

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
is_new_high = highestbars(period=252)(close) == 0

# --- VIX Regime Classification ---
# Low < 15, Medium 15-25, High > 25
vix_regime_num = conditional_select(
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 15, 0,
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 25, 1,
    is_valid(vix), 2,
    -1
)
regime_label = conditional_select(
    vix_regime_num == 0, "Low VIX (<15)",
    vix_regime_num == 1, "Med VIX (15-25)",
    vix_regime_num == 2, "High VIX (>25)",
    "Unknown"
)

# --- Forward Returns (look-ahead for research) ---
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Filter: forward returns only on new-high days ---
fwd_5d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_5d)
fwd_21d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_63d)

# --- Regime-filtered forward returns ---
is_low = is_new_high and vix_regime_num == 0
is_med = is_new_high and vix_regime_num == 1
is_hi = is_new_high and vix_regime_num == 2

fwd_5d_low = where(is_low, fwd_5d)
fwd_21d_low = where(is_low, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_low = where(is_low, fwd_63d)

fwd_5d_med = where(is_med, fwd_5d)
fwd_21d_med = where(is_med, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_med = where(is_med, fwd_63d)

fwd_5d_hi = where(is_hi, fwd_5d)
fwd_21d_hi = where(is_hi, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_hi = where(is_hi, fwd_63d)

# --- Event count per regime ---
cnt_low = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if (is_valid(is_low) and is_low) else 0.0)
cnt_med = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if (is_valid(is_med) and is_med) else 0.0)
cnt_hi = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if (is_valid(is_hi) and is_hi) else 0.0)

# --- Hit rates per regime (ternary for correct calculation) ---
hit_21d_low = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_21d_low) and fwd_21d_low > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_21d_low) else fwd_21d_low
hit_21d_med = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_21d_med) and fwd_21d_med > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_21d_med) else fwd_21d_med
hit_21d_hi = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_21d_hi) and fwd_21d_hi > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_21d_hi) else fwd_21d_hi

# --- VIX level at each new high (for event markers) ---
vix_at_high = where(is_new_high, vix)
regime_at_high = where(is_new_high, regime_label)

# --- Output 1: Punchline — Median forward returns by horizon × VIX regime ---
# Grouped bars: stacks = regimes, series names = horizons
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does VIX Regime Change the Drift After New Highs?',
    category='52-Week High × VIX Regime',
    color_by_value=False,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Cyan, stack='Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d', color=Color.Cyan, stack='Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d', color=Color.Cyan, stack='Low VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Med VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Med VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Med VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Red, stack='High VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d', color=Color.Red, stack='High VIX'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d', color=Color.Red, stack='High VIX')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(
    fwd_5d_low, fwd_21d_low, fwd_63d_low,
    fwd_5d_med, fwd_21d_med, fwd_63d_med,
    fwd_5d_hi, fwd_21d_hi, fwd_63d_hi
))

# --- Output 2: Distribution — Boxplot of 21d returns grouped by VIX regime ---
# Uses grouped mode with regime label as category
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='Is the 1-Month Return Regime-Dependent?',
    category='52-Week High × VIX Regime',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    colors=[Color.Cyan, Color.Blue, Color.Red],
    show_data_labels=True,
    order=2
)(label=where(is_new_high, regime_label), values=fwd_21d_at_high)

# --- Output 3: Event markers with VIX context ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+63d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_at_high, close, vix, fwd_21d, fwd_63d, is_new_high)

# --- Output 4: Summary table — regime-segmented stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Forward Return Stats by VIX Regime',
        row_size=5, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Median +21d', 'Hit Rate +21d', 'Best +21d', 'Worst +21d'],
        col_headers=['Low VIX (<15)', 'Med VIX (15-25)', 'High VIX (>25)'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Event count per regime
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median 21d return per regime
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Hit rate (mean of 1/0 flags)
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best 21d return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 4: Worst 21d return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='52-Week High × VIX Regime',
    order=3
)(
    # Row 0: event counts
    cnt_low, cnt_med, cnt_hi,
    # Row 1: 21d returns for median
    fwd_21d_low, fwd_21d_med, fwd_21d_hi,
    # Row 2: hit flags for mean
    hit_21d_low, hit_21d_med, hit_21d_hi,
    # Row 3: 21d returns for max (best)
    fwd_21d_low, fwd_21d_med, fwd_21d_hi,
    # Row 4: 21d returns for min (worst)
    fwd_21d_low, fwd_21d_med, fwd_21d_hi
)
